summary.headline: Testing a Prophet by Horoscopy
summary.text: An anecdote recounts a horoscopic warning ignored by travelers who then encountered robbers, followed by section 5 on determining whether a self-proclaimed prophet tells the truth, featuring Apomasar, Caliph al-Mamun, and a chart with the Sun, Moon, lots of fortune and daimon, Capricorn, Jupiter, and Venus.
